# Growatt fixture

`growatt_inverter_telemetry_2026-03-13_14.csv`: every row of 13 and 14 March 2026 of `Inverter Telemetry.xlsx`
(same columns and values, written as CSV) from the Kaggle dataset "Residential Solar Power Generation Dataset"
(`anishth/solar-power-output`): a real 3 kW rooftop system with a Growatt inverter in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India.
Downloaded on 2026-10-16.

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), as stated on the dataset page
(https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/anishth/solar-power-output).
